sql: SELECT CAST(LAST_DAY(DATE '2024-02-10') AS STRING) AS v
SELECT CAST(DATE_ADD(DATE '2024-01-31', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS STRING) AS v
note: value correct (month-end clamp) but DuckDB widens DATE+INTERVAL to TIMESTAMP -> '2024-02-29 00:00:00'

sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_ADD(DATE '2024-02-29', INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AS STRING) AS v
note: DATE+INTERVAL widens to TIMESTAMP in DuckDB

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(WEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-07') AS v
SELECT EXTRACT(ISOWEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-01') AS v
SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-07') AS v
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-W%W-%u', DATE '2024-01-07') AS v
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-01-10', INTERVAL 2 DAY)) AS v
SELECT CAST(CAST(10 AS NUMERIC) / CAST(3 AS NUMERIC) AS STRING) AS v
note: BigQuery NUMERIC keeps fixed scale 9; DECIMAL translation yields DOUBLE 3.3333333333333335

sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(CAST(2.5 AS BIGNUMERIC)) AS STRING) AS v

note: BigQuery raises INT64 overflow; DuckDB translation also raises OutOfRange -> consistent rejection, not a pass

sql: SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH([1, NULL, 2]) AS v
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(CAST([] AS ARRAY<INT64>)) AS v
SELECT ('a_b' LIKE 'a\_b') AS v
note: BigQuery LIKE escapes with backslash so matches literal 'a_b' (true); DuckDB LIKE does not escape with backslash -> false. Silent wrong filter

sql: SELECT ('axb' LIKE 'a\_b') AS v
SELECT ('abc' = COLLATE('ABC', 'und:ci')) AS v
SELECT CAST(SAFE_CAST('notanumber' AS INT64) AS STRING) AS v
SELECT CAST(DATETIME(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 23:30:00+00', 'Asia/Kolkata') AS STRING) AS v
SELECT CAST(DATE(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 23:30:00+00', 'Asia/Kolkata') AS STRING) AS v
DECLARE d DATE DEFAULT DATE '2024-01-31'; SET d = DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 MONTH); SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) AS v
note: binding correct (d=2024-02-29); inherits DATE_ADD DATE->TIMESTAMP widening

sql: DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT 7 * 6; SELECT n AS v
